SOPV 2026: Een subsidieaanvraag is pas z: SOPV 2026: A grant application only makes sense when you know which production test, investment and supporting documents you can actually deliver. For plastics processors, that is now relevant: the revised Subsidie Omschakeling Plasticverwerkers (SOPV) scheme has been open since 6 October 2026. This is a different scheme from the CPNL round, which closed on 6 October.
Volgens RVO mogen ondernemers in 2026 pr: According to RVO, businesses can carry out production tests with more types of polymers in 2026, including elastomers, thermosets and composite materials. The total budget is €2.2 million. Up to €25,000 in funding is available per application, and each business can receive a grant only once. Applications are open until 15 December 2026 at 17:00. Check the current conditions and available funding with RVO.
Een producent wil meer gerecycled of bio: A manufacturer wants to use more recycled or bio-based material, but the test plan sits with production, cost prices with finance and supplier information with procurement. No one has a single overview of whether the test is feasible, financeable and eligible for a grant. This can lead to missed deadlines, incomplete applications or investment decisions made without insight into risk and working capital. These are possible consequences, not measured losses for a particular company.
Begin met de vraag of de eigen productie: Start by checking whether your production test falls within the current scheme. For each test, record the material type, supplier, production line, responsible person, costs, own financing, supporting documents and decision date. Check the official conditions before treating any grant amount as expected funding in your budget. Make uncertainties visible and assign an owner to every missing step.

Powerhouse kan het externe RVO-signaal v: Powerhouse can link RVO's external signal to a company's own product, process and financial data. The system can create a contextual action card, flag missing information, place the deadline on the roadmap and present the impact on budget, capacity and risk for review. Without customer data, that impact is a hypothesis, not a proven saving or grant award.
